zh.title: 美國航空首架改裝波音777-300ER客機返美
zh.summary: 美國航空首架波音777客機在香港完成八個月改裝後飛返DFW機場（DFW）
body: 美國航空已成功完成其首架客艙改裝波音777-300ER客機的飛渡航班，將該架飛機送回達拉斯-沃斯堡國際機場。這架民用寬體客機先前被安置於香港，並在當地進行了為期長達8個月的客艙翻新與改裝工程。
在香港順利完成這項為期8個月的翻修與改裝工程後，這架機齡達13年的客機重新返回美國航空機隊。這架完成改裝的客機為旅客配備了多項升級後的客艙設施，其中包括尺寸更大的個人娛樂系統螢幕、藍牙音訊配對功能，以及提高乘客個人隱私的隱私門。

en.title: American Airlines Ferries First Retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER Back to DFW (DFW)
en.summary: American Airlines has returned its first retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER to DFW after a Hong Kong overhaul.
body: American Airlines has completed the ferry flight of its first retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER passenger aircraft, returning the jet back to Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport . The commercial aircraft had been positioned in Hong Kong, where it underwent an extensive cabin retrofit and overhaul program that lasted for eight months.

Following the completion of this eight-month overhaul in Hong Kong, the thirteen-year-old aircraft has returned to the United States. The refurbished jet is equipped with several upgraded cabin features for passengers, which include larger entertainment screens, wireless Bluetooth pairing capabilities, and individual privacy doors.
